name: Odani
text: Dissolved municipality in Higashiazai district, Shiga prefecture, Japan.

depictions.name: Odani
depictions.text: Odani Castle Odani was a castle situated in northern Goshiki Outlands in Ōmi, Japan. Its ruins have been preserved as a national historical site since 2005.
